subject: Accelerated renewal + mid-term top-up: AWS Private Offer onramp checklist
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@aurorahealth.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: David Liu <david.liu@aurorahealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Need to accelerate renewal + mid-term top-up (AWS private offer)

Hi Priyom,

Quick context: Aurora is close to exhausting committed capacity ahead of our planned renewal window. Our finance and procurement teams asked whether we can lock a short mid-term top-up and accelerate acceptance of the AWS private offer so we capture existing marketplace credits before they expire at quarter-end.

Can Redwood support a 6-month top-up on top of our existing 12‑month commit, keep the same SKU and pricing band, and let us sign a private-offer amendment before 4/15? We can route via our procurement team and need a PO-ready PDF to attach to our internal approval flow.

High level asks:
- Mid-term capacity top-up: +30% committed vCPU-equivalent (reconciled to current usage)
- Same unit pricing / no repricing mid-term
- Invoice timing: single PO, invoice split acceptable (finance prefers two tranches)
- Target sign-off: 4/15

I can be on a short call this afternoon if helpful — David (cc) will own the PO.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Cloud Procurement
Aurora Health

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@aurorahealth.ai>
Cc: David Liu <david.liu@aurorahealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2028 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to accelerate renewal + mid-term top-up (AWS private offer)

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. We can support an accelerated path here. Quick plan:

1) I'll send an editable PO draft and a short SOW for the mid-term top-up by EOD.
2) Ben (cc) will confirm pricing bands and confirm we can lock the same SKU/pricing for the top-up period.
3) Marissa (cc) will coordinate the marketplace private-offer paperwork (AWS) and confirm acceptance checklist / timeline.
4) Soojin (cc) will confirm billing split options and whether we need any accounting addenda.

Can you confirm the internal PO owner (David) will sign the PO PDF and whether DocuSign is acceptable? If you confirm, we will aim to get a DocuSign-ready PO to you by Monday 4/4 so procurement has time to process before 4/15.

Call availability: 2–3pm PT today works for me if that helps to quick-align.

—Priyom
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2028 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to accelerate renewal + mid-term top-up (AWS private offer)

Priyom — quick pricing note: we can hold current unit pricing for the mid-term top-up if the customer commits to a PO for the delta (+30%) and signs the private-offer amendment. Recommended approach:

- Keep base 12-month commitment untouched.
- Add a 6-month top-up layer tied to the private offer; pricing parity with current band.
- No retroactive repricing; top-up is treated as a new tranche on the same SKU.

I'll attach a clean PO draft (Aurora_PO_Draft_v3.pdf) with line items broken into tranche A (existing) and tranche B (top-up). Marissa — can you confirm the AWS private offer constraints for staggered invoice acceptance?

—Ben
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 1 Apr 2028 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to accelerate renewal + mid-term top-up (AWS private offer)

Ben / team — AWS-side checklist:
- Private Offer must be created with final PO amount and accepted before the credits expiration to preserve marketplace credits.
- We can request split invoicing via our billing flow, but acceptance must reference the private-offer ID; staggered invoice delivery is allowed if Finance approves.
- Need the final PO and SOW to create the private-offer draft in the marketplace console (I will own submission).

Action items for this thread:
- Priyom: get customer PO and preferred invoice split (1 or 2 tranches).
- Ben: confirm final dollars and SKU mapping (done — see attached PO v3).
- Soojin: confirm whether we can accept the PO with a two-tranche invoicing schedule and whether accounting needs an addendum.

Timeline: to meet 4/15 we need signed PO by 4/9 COB to allow internal submission and AWS processing. If Aurora can sign earlier we can expedite.

—Marissa
Head, Cloud Marketplace Ops
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 4 Apr 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to accelerate renewal + mid-term top-up (AWS private offer)

Team — accounting check: two-tranche invoicing is OK. Notes:
- We will generate two invoices linked to the same private-offer acceptance ID; finance will need a billing contact and PO reference on each invoice.
- For revenue recognition we need the SOW midpoint deliverable listed (simple sentence) so rev rec has a trigger for the top-up tranche.
- Addendum not required for split invoice, but customer must sign the PO indicating tranche breakdown and billing emails.

I created a short SOW template and populated it with the top-up language — attached as SOW_midterm_topup.xlsx. Priyom: please confirm the billing email and whether Aurora needs the invoices routed to their Ariba system (if so give us the vendor code).

—Soojin
Head of Revenue Operations
From: David Liu <david.liu@aurorahealth.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@aurorahealth.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to accelerate renewal + mid-term top-up (AWS private offer)

Priyom — attaching signed PO (signed copy sent via DocuSign link). We accepted the tranche split (60% now / 40% at month 3) and confirm DocuSign routing is fine. Please proceed with private-offer submission to AWS.

PO notes: please ensure the private-offer ID is on invoice line items and the SOW language includes the usage metric anchor (vCPU-equivalent). Our Ariba vendor code is AH-00451; route invoices there.

Next steps:
- Redwood to submit private-offer and share marketplace ID + DocuSign envelope id.
- Redwood billing to issue invoice tranche A on acceptance.
- Coordinate a short 15-minute handoff with our procurement (Olivia) and your ops/legal if AWS requests minor term clarifications.

Thanks,
David Liu
Procurement Manager | Aurora Health
